_note: Nat_multitask_resnetv2_50 (multi-task CNN, trainer train/train_multi_task_cnn.py): BiT (Big Transfer) ResNetV2-50x1 pretrained on ImageNet-21k and fine-tuned on ImageNet-1k (resnetv2_50x1_bit.goog_in21k_ft_in1k via timm) with two linear heads (crop 55, disease 175) and CE + label smoothing 0.1. Direct port of hyperparameters from independent_cnn_baseline_bit50_r1_seed42 to multitask (lr_backbone 2e-5, lr_head 2e-4, weight_decay 0.05, warmup_epochs 3, min_lr_ratio 0.01, random_resized_crop_scale [0.5, 1.0], effective batch size 32 via batch_size 16 x accum_steps 2, grad_clip_norm 1.0, head_dropout 0.2, patience 8 over 30 epochs).

data._note: Evaluation on test seen (2,000) and test unseen (1,448) across all 333 composition pairs.

model._note: BiT ResNetV2-50x1 pretrained backbone with dual linear heads (crop 55, disease 175). Head dropout tuned to 0.2 matching R1 baseline for optimal regularization on long-tailed classes.

input._note: 256x256 standardized resized cache with 224x224 center crop for evaluation.

augmentation._note: Augmentation aligned with R1: random_resized_crop_scale [0.5, 1.0] preserves local plant disease lesions (avoiding overly aggressive crops down to 0.25 that remove symptom context) with flips and subtle color jitter.

loss._note: Joint cross-entropy with label smoothing 0.1 on both heads. Equal weighting (1.0 / 1.0) provides a balanced multi-task objective.

optimizer._note: AdamW with conservative learning rates ported from R1: lr_backbone 2e-5 and lr_head 2e-4. These lower rates prevent destructive updates to the shared feature extractor from dual-head gradient interference.
optimizer.name: adamw

scheduler._note: Cosine annealing scheduler with 3 warmup epochs (matching R1) decaying to min_lr_ratio 0.01 over 30 epochs.
scheduler.name: cosine

validation._note: Held-out pseudo-unseen validation (15% split, 20 holdout pairs, max 40 images/pair) sweeping gamma [0.0, 10.0] in 0.1 increments to choose optimal stopping epoch and calibration gamma.

training._note: Direct port of independent_cnn_baseline_bit50_r1_seed42 hyperparameters to multi-task: effective batch size 32 (batch_size 16 x accum_steps 2), gradient clipping 1.0, patience 8 over 30 max epochs.

evaluation._note: Standard DPD benchmark metrics: Top-1, Top-5, per-class means, and Harmonic Mean (HM).

runtime._note: AMP mixed precision on CUDA with 4 workers. Periodic checkpoints every 5 epochs for resume support.
